text: Shiplake Properties Ltd. (the "Applicant") has applied for a Zoning By-law Amendment (the "Application") for the property municipally known as 22 Balliol Street (the "Site"). The Applicant initially submitted their Application on February 23, 2016, and proposed the construction of a 38 storey mixed-use rental building containing 425 dwelling units on the Site. On October 26, 2017, the Applicant appealed the Application to the Local Planning Appeal Tribunal, now the Ontario Land Tribunal, for non-decision (the "Appeal"). An OLT hearing for this matter was initially scheduled for twelve days intended to commence on September 27, 2021. In addition to the City and the Applicant, the South Eglinton Ratepayers' and Residents' Association ("SERRA") is also a party to the Appeal. City Council direct that the balance of Confidential Attachment 1 to the report (September 22, 2021) from the City Solicitor remain confidential at the discretion of the City Solicitor, as it contains advice that is subject to solicitor-client privilege.
